mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish on the weather, which features clear skies at Verona Community Park and a pleasant temperature of 73 degrees.

The City of Verona Department of Public Works is currently recruiting an Engineering Technician to manage municipal and utility construction projects, including everything from street rehabilitation to infrastructure development. Interested candidates can apply online through the city website by 11:59 PM on September 20.

We have a busy schedule today including live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus a Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena. Looking ahead, you can join a yoga session tomorrow at Insight Wellness or participate in trivia nights starting this Monday.
Regarding local safety, on August 15, officers responded to a report of a vehicle swerving near North Main Street, which led to the arrest of a 44-year-old woman for her first O W I offence.

Culver's is serving up their tasty Caramel Cashew flavor of the day and is open until 10 PM. Additionally, you can visit Kona Ice at Fireman's Park between 11 AM and 5 PM today, or at the Verona Area High School stadium from 1 PM until 7:30 PM.
